One seed and one epoch per cell. Workload size changes training and total optimizer updates; architecture comparisons also change tokenizer and pretraining history, so differences are descriptive rather than causal.

Privacy floors concern two fixed scoring attacks and registered finite public-data pools under independent with-replacement sampling, not all attacks or an external population. The pseudorandom audit draw design and all trials are fixed before measurement.
The full MRA taxonomy, per-threat theoretical ceilings, calibrated LiRA/RMIA shadow models, canary insertion, independent review and production release gate are not executed by this experiment.
A null attack result does not clear privacy. Ceiling 1 is an explicit worst-case bound. No acceptance threshold or release verdict is inferred after observing results.
Preregistration here is a local hash-bound declaration, not a trusted external timestamp or independently attested workload.
Cached model bytes and dataset bytes are hash-pinned locally; this run does not independently authenticate their upstream origin or infer pretraining membership.
No trained weights are exported and no model is authorized for deployment. Existing source code and JSON schemas remain unchanged.
